item.title: Exhaustism 0.3.0
item.description:
0.3.0 — The audit burn: honest numbers, disclosed fallbacks

  • Design RPM is saved with the design — it was being silently discarded, and the Designer and the Algebraic quick-check each kept a private target (4,500 vs 6,000). One scavengingTargetRPM now, shared by both, persisted. Sound keeps its own separate target — scavenging and sound are different physics at different rpm.
  • Every sweep is stamped with its run conditions — ambient, fuel, throttle and model flags travel with the result and into the CSV export, so two sweeps can be compared honestly after the fact.
  • MCSA ceiling: a preset's measured minimum cross-section area now caps effective valve area. No default is invented — unmeasured presets ship nil and the solver says so. Wide-open goldens are bit-identical to 0.2.1.
  • Fallbacks now disclose themselves: a 6→2 build that solves as a single collector shows a SOLVED AS SINGLE COLLECTOR badge (persisted, exported) instead of quietly answering a different question; merge advice carries a clocking disclosure; plenum advisory added.
  • New diagnostic: intake-port pressure trace per RPM point — the ram sequence is now visible next to the exhaust pulse.

item.title: Exhaustism 0.2.1
item.description:
0.2.1 — Licensing, quality of life, lighter launch

  • License system (offline, no phone-home): install a signed .exhaustlic in Settings ▸ License. The alpha stays soft-gated — nothing locks.
  • Spacebar toggles the pressure-field playhead app-wide, or Live Rev play/stop while that tab is visible.
  • WAV export no longer freezes the app — background synthesis with a real progress bar.
  • Live Rev volume knob, persisted; pure listener gain, the dB numbers never move.
  • Much lighter launch: saved results now load from the project sidecar on demand instead of all at once — typical launch memory drops from ~800 MB to ~220 MB on a large result store. Charts render identically once loaded; project files are unchanged.

item.title: Exhaustism 0.2.0
item.description:
0.2.0 — Part throttle (FEA-1)

  • The throttle is now a real lever, not a hidden slider. New Throttle control in the Intake & Combustion inspector.
  • With the intake model ON: the butterfly is a genuine variable restriction (1−cos θ plate law) feeding each ITB runner — manifold vacuum, trapped mass and the exhaust pulse emerge from the gas dynamics.
  • Without the intake model: an honest manifold-pressure map scales the blowdown seed (documented approximation, help text says which model you get).
  • Live Rev throttle slider restored; part-throttle sweeps supported.
  • New diagnostics: EVO seed pressure and trapped-charge temperature.
  • Wide-open-throttle results are bit-identical to 0.1.1.

item.title: Exhaustism 0.1.1
item.description:
0.1.1

  • Unified Dozo theme across every view.
  • Sound-grade 3.5 mm mesh option (timbre band recovered above 800 Hz).
  • Intake & Combustion inspector (ITB runner + Wiebe closed-cycle).
  • Reverse-cone tip now modeled on full cat/resonator/muffler chains.
  • New sidecar document format: autosave writes ~11 MB instead of 226 MB.
